# Local Three.js distribution

Version: **three 0.174.0** (MIT).

Files copied from the npm registry's three@0.174.0 package using npm pack:
- build/three.module.js
- build/three.core.js
- examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js
- LICENSE (stored as THREE-LICENSE.txt)

The import map resolves `three` locally. No external CDN is needed at runtime. These are upstream distribution files; do not edit them to change application behavior.
